⚙️ Execution Mechanics

  • Dual Limit OCO Bracket placed at 4H candle open ($t=0$).
  • Upper Order: Limit Sell Short at Liquidity Sweep Target ($+1.5\%$).
  • Lower Order: Limit Buy Long at Liquidity Sweep Target ($-1.5\%$).
  • First order filled automatically cancels opposite order (OCO).
  • Take Profit Target: +25% Margin ROI ($+1.25\%$ price rebound at 20x).
  • Stop Loss: -25% Margin Risk ($-1.25\%$ adverse price move).

📊 Microstructure Edge

  • Leverage Target: 1.5% distance correlates to 50x–65x liquidation clusters.
  • Session Bias Filter: Avoids weekend low-volume traps; prioritizes London & NY overlap.
  • Realistic Fees: Binance Futures VIP 0 fees (0.02% maker, 0.05% taker) + 0.01% slippage deducted on every trade.
  • Strict 1 Trade / Day Rule prevents overtrading during high-volatility cascades.
